subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, with the PR's no-override defaults and `minimal | standard | full` hook-extra semantics?
rationale: The code path is bounded and proven at the function level, but choosing a new prompt-context config/default surface affects session context, upgrades, hook-loaded files, and overlapping bootstrap-control proposals.

options.title: Sponsor Current Tier Contract

options.title: Fold Into Broader Bootstrap Control

options.title: Decline New Config Knob
options.body: Keep existing fixed filters and steer users toward current context-injection, budget, lightweight, or doctor guidance instead of adding `bootstrapTier`.
